int_name: N OPAL ST & W YORK ST

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is characterized by a lack of formal crossing infrastructure at an intersection of a main road and a narrow side street. The presence of vacant lots and poorly maintained pavement, combined with a lack of traffic control and lane markings, creates a hostile environment for walking.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: No marked crosswalks or signage exist to facilitate safe pedestrian crossing across the main roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Intersection of the foreground road and the side street.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: A vehicle parked close to the intersection corner on the left obscures visibility between pedestrians and oncoming traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the intersection.

hazards.name: Degraded Infrastructure
hazards.description: Cracked and uneven pavement on the roadway and sidewalk edges creates trip hazards.
hazards.location_in_image: Throughout the foreground and sidewalk areas.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking near the intersection to improve sightlines for both drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and slow turning traffic.

result.summary: This residential intersection lacks basic pedestrian infrastructure such as marked crosswalks and curb ramps. Significant overgrown vegetation on the right side completely obstructs the sidewalk, likely forcing pedestrians to walk in the roadway.

hazards.name: Overgrown Vegetation
hazards.description: Dense vegetation completely blocks the sidewalk on the right side, forcing pedestrians into the roadway and obstructing sightlines.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image along the sidewalk

hazards.name: Lack of Marked Crosswalks
hazards.description: No designated crossing area is provided at the intersection, increasing risk for pedestrians crossing the street.
hazards.location_in_image: Intersection area in the foreground

hazards.name: Utility Pole Obstruction
hazards.description: A utility pole is positioned directly in the corner pedestrian area, narrowing the accessible path.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground center-left at the corner

interventions.title: Vegetation Clearing and Maintenance
interventions.description: Trim or remove the overgrown vegetation to restore the full width of the sidewalk for pedestrian use.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian space and alert drivers.

interventions.title: ADA Compliant Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install curb ramps with detectable warning surfaces to provide an accessible path of travel.

result.summary: A narrow residential street with sidewalks on both sides, though the left side is significantly obstructed by overgrown vegetation. The pavement and crosswalk markings are in poor condition, and there is a lack of formal traffic control or lighting visible.

hazards.name: Overgrown Vegetation
hazards.description: Dense vegetation completely blocks the left sidewalk, forcing pedestrians to walk in the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the street

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk
hazards.description: The crosswalk markings are severely worn and barely visible, reducing driver awareness of the crossing.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground roadway

hazards.name: Debris and Poor Pavement
hazards.description: Trash and uneven pavement surfaces create tripping hazards for pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Throughout the sidewalk and gutter areas

interventions.title: Vegetation Clearance
interventions.description: Clear the overgrown bushes and trees on the left side to restore the full width of the sidewalk.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Repaint the crossing with high-visibility continental markings to improve driver yielding.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Lighting
interventions.description: Install street lighting to improve visibility and safety for pedestrians during nighttime hours.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is characterized by severely degraded sidewalks and a lack of formal crossing infrastructure. Pedestrians are visible walking along the edge of the roadway, likely due to the poor condition and obstructions on the existing walkway.

hazards.name: Degraded Sidewalk Surface
hazards.description: The sidewalk is heavily cracked with significant vegetation growth, creating trip hazards and making it inaccessible for those with mobility aids.
hazards.location_in_image: Right foreground and midground along the roadway edge

hazards.name: Pedestrians in Roadway
hazards.description: Pedestrians are walking in the street due to poor sidewalk conditions and parked vehicle obstructions.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the road next to the silver car

hazards.name: Lack of Marked Crossings
hazards.description: There are no visible marked crosswalks or pedestrian warning signs at the intersection or along the block.
hazards.location_in_image: Entire roadway visible

interventions.title: Sidewalk Reconstruction
interventions.description: Repair and level the existing sidewalk to provide a continuous, ADA-compliant walking surface.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks and Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install high-visibility marked crosswalks and ADA-compliant curb ramps at intersections.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions (bulb-outs) to shorten crossing distances and prevent vehicles from parking too close to intersections or on sidewalks.
